rule_title: TTP T1482 - New domain trust created
description: Detects creation of a new trusted domain relationship (Event 4706). In the observed data, Administrator on MYPARTNER created a bidirectional forest trust (TdoDirection=3, TdoAttributes=8) with rootblue.lan, with SID filtering disabled. This enables cross-forest lateral movement and is a high-severity persistence/escalation technique.
